name: diamond-rain
description: The Planet That Rains Diamonds — a 3D short documentary built with Remotion + React Three Fiber

scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts DiamondRainVertical out/diamond-rain-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl=angle
scripts.render:wide: remotion render src/index.ts DiamondRainWide out/diamond-rain-wide.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --gl=angle
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:wide
